name: Order Platform - Observability
description: Painel unificado de observabilidade da Order Platform gerado via CI/CD.

pages.name: Visão Geral & Negócio
pages.description: Volumetria e fluxo de processamento de Pedidos (HTTP & RabbitMQ)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Total Criados' FROM Transaction WHERE name = 'WebTransaction/SpringController/api/orders (POST)' AND httpResponseCode LIKE '2%' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Total Processados' FROM Log WHERE message LIKE '%Evento de pedido processado com sucesso%'   AND entity.name = 'Order Platform API' SINCE 1 HOUR AGO

SELECT   (filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE '%Pedido criado com sucesso%') -    filter(count(*), WHERE message LIKE '%Evento de pedido processado com sucesso%'))    AS 'Pendentes'FROM Log WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API'SINCE 1 HOUR AGO

SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE (name = 'WebTransaction/SpringController/api/orders (POST)' OR name = 'WebTransaction/SpringController/api/products (POST)') AND (httpResponseCode LIKE '4%' OR httpResponseCode LIKE '5%') FACET name, httpResponseCode SINCE 1 HOUR AGO

widgets.title: Fluxo de Criação vs Processamento (Minuto a Minuto)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'Order Platform API' FACET cases(WHERE name LIKE '%OrderController%' OR name LIKE '%/orders%' AS 'Pedidos Criados (HTTP)', WHERE transactionType = 'OtherTransaction' OR name LIKE '%Rabbit%' AS 'Pedidos Processados (Queue)')TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 1 hour ago

pages.name: Performance & Diagnóstico
pages.description: Latências de API, erros HTTP e rastreabilidade de requisições

widgets.title: Tempo de Resposta (Percentis p50, p90, p99)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentiles(duration, 50, 90, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API' AND transactionType = 'Web' TIMESERIES SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API' AND http.statusCode >= '400' FACET http.statusCode, name SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT timestamp, `error.type`, `error.message`, name FROM TransactionError WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API' SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50
SELECT timestamp, trace.id, spanId, name, duration FROM Transaction WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API' AND (error IS true OR duration > 1) SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50

pages.name: Infraestrutura & JVM
pages.description: Métricas de consumo de Heap JVM e utilização de CPU

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(apm.service.memory.heap.used) / 1024 / 1024 AS 'Heap Usada (MB)', average(apm.service.memory.heap.max) / 1024 / 1024 AS 'Heap Máxima (MB)' FROM Metric WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API' TIMESERIES SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Uso de CPU (% Aplicação vs Sistema)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(apm.service.cpu.usertime.utilization) * 100 AS 'CPU Processo (%)', average(apm.service.cpu.systemtime.utilization) * 100 AS 'CPU Sistema (%)' FROM Metric WHERE entity.name = 'Order Platform API' TIMESERIES SINCE 1 hour ago
